title: Cebu's Progella makes history with Asian Games beach volleyball bronze

blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — Cebuana Khylem Progella and her partner Sofiah Pagara made history for Philippine beach volleyball on Friday, rallying from a set down to defeat China’s Cao Shuting and Dong Jie, 13–21, 23–21, 15–13, and capture the women’s bronze medal at the 20th Asian Games at the Hekinan Ryokuchi Beach Court.
